initial_metadata_read_failure.message: FETCH_HEAD temporarily unavailable during concurrent results fetch
initial_metadata_read_failure.scope: Root launched source FETCH_HEAD read and another fetch in the same worktree concurrently. This was an operational ordering mistake; source worktree creation had not started and no scientific artifact was changed.
initial_metadata_read_failure.correction: Waited for fetch completion, used the explicit source SHA, then read the completed results FETCH_HEAD and created both worktrees sequentially.
